senses.definition_en: to carburize

examples.english: Iron and steel foundries use them, likewise, to carburize steel and wash molds in order to give a softer and more uniform finish to molten steel objects.
examples.text: Las fundiciones siderúrgicas lo usan, igualmente, para carburizar el acero y para lavar los moldes a fin de dar un acabado más suave y uniforme a los artículos de acero fundido.

examples.english: Steels with 3.5% nickel and a low carbon content are used to carburize transmission gears, connecting rod screws, bolts and locks.
examples.ref: 2014, Segundo Barroso Herrero, Joaquín Ibáñez Ulargui, Introducción al conocimiento de materiales, Editorial UNED, →ISBN, page 224:
examples.text: Los aceros al 3.5% de níquel con bajo contenido de carbono se emplean para carburizar engranajes de transmisión, tornillos de bielas, pernos y seguros.
examples.translation: Steels with 3.5% nickel and a low carbon content are used to carburize transmission gears, connecting rod screws, bolts and locks.

glosses: to carburize

senses.definition_en: locker; locking file cabinet

examples.english: A file cabinet and a safe, a sofa, four chairs and a black wooden desk made up the furniture of that room, at the same time intimate and administrative.
examples.ref: 1905, Luis Ruiz Contreras (tr.), El señor Bergeret en París, translation of Monsieur Bergeret à Paris by Anatole France, published 1901, Capítulo XI:
examples.text: Una taquilla y una caja de caudales, un sofá, cuatro sillas y un escritorio de madera negra componían el mobiliario de aquella habitación, a la vez íntima y administrativa.
examples.translation: A file cabinet and a safe, a sofa, four chairs and a black wooden desk made up the furniture of that room, at the same time intimate and administrative.

examples.english: He cooled down a little and, with a determined stride, headed for the changing room. It was very late. But when he prepared to open his locker with the key, he felt suddenly dizzy and rested his head against the metal panel for a few moments.
examples.ref: ante 2009, Leopoldo Alas Mínguez, “La Taquilla”, in La loca aventura de vivir, page 40:
examples.text: Se refrescó un poco y, con paso decidido, se encaminó al vestuario. Eran las tantas. Pero cuando se disponía a abrir su taquilla con la llave, sintió un repentino mareo y apoyó la cabeza contra la chapa metálica durante unos instantes.
examples.translation: He cooled down a little and, with a determined stride, headed for the changing room. It was very late. But when he prepared to open his locker with the key, he felt suddenly dizzy and rested his head against the metal panel for a few moments.

glosses: locker; locking file cabinet
